# Demand Journeys

> Independent marketing, search visibility, growth and marketing technology advisory. Singapore-based, working across APAC. Official website: https://www.demandjourneys.com/

## About the practice
- [Overview](https://www.demandjourneys.com/): Commercial marketing perspective and enquiry form.
- [Profile](https://www.demandjourneys.com/profile/): Professional background of the founder, Meng Liang Tan.
- [Services](https://www.demandjourneys.com/services/): Advisory work across search, growth and platforms.
- [Hospitality and travel](https://www.demandjourneys.com/hospitality/): Hospitality commercial systems, distribution, conversion and retention.

## Expertise
- [AI search: SEO, AEO and GEO](https://www.demandjourneys.com/ai-search/): AI-answer discoverability, evidence and measurement.
- [Growth marketing](https://www.demandjourneys.com/services/growth-marketing/): Acquisition, conversion and customer value.
- [Platforms and analytics](https://www.demandjourneys.com/services/platforms-analytics/): Data, MarTech and measurement.
- [Engagement scopes](https://www.demandjourneys.com/services/engagements/): Ways to structure diagnostic and advisory work.
